description.value: Silkscarf is a family boutique estate winery that has operated under the same founding proprietors and winemakers since 2004, making it one of the longer-running family wineries in the Okanagan. The estate cultivates over 10 varieties across 10-plus acres of class-1 terroir on the Summerland Bench Sub-GI, with a declared commitment to sustainable farming. Touring cyclists on the Naramata–Summerland bench roads can stop for a tasting and browse an extensive library collection of older vintages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM phone number and street address; the website consistently identifies the municipality as Summerland, BC rather than Naramata as tagged in OSM, so the address is updated to the website version and the discrepancy is flagged. No mention of bike facilities, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site. Wine pickup from the storefront is explicitly described on the contact page, confirming a takeout option.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Naramata' but website consistently identifies the municipality as 'Summerland, BC V0H1Z4'; address updated to match website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Silkscarf is a long-established estate winery with a tasting room directly on the Summerland–Naramata bench cycling corridor, a core attraction for touring cyclists in this region; the business is active and confirmed open.
